## What's new in Kraki 0.2.81
- **Faster on this Mac:** when the agent runs on the same Mac as the Kraki app, the two now talk to each other directly instead of going through the Kraki server. Replies, streaming text, tool steps and images from this Mac arrive with no network round trip. - **Steadier on a shaky connection:** if your Mac's internet blips, the agent's live replies from this Mac keep arriving, and its notifications show up on time instead of in a pile of outdated ones when the connection comes back. - **Other devices are unchanged:** your iPhone and your other computers keep working exactly as before and see everything that happens on this Mac. - **Fix:** a short piece of the agent's live text could occasionally show up twice right after opening a conversation.

## What's new in Kraki 0.2.80
- **Forking is instant:** copying a conversation now takes a fraction of a second, even for very long ones, and opens straight into the copy with its full history, no "Starting session…" wait. Copies are numbered ("Fork 2 of …") so you can tell them apart. - **Forking while the agent is working:** the copy ends with a clear "Stopped" note instead of a question that never gets answered. - **Sending right after opening a long conversation:** your message shows up immediately instead of hiding under the message box until the reply arrives. - **Voice input:** the first-use notice and settings now say plainly that recordings and corrections are handled by third-party cloud services. - **Privacy:** Kraki no longer stores your GitHub token in its background service settings.

## What's new in Kraki 0.2.79
- **Voice cut off mid-message:** if your connection stalls while you dictate, the words heard so far go back into the message box with a short note saying what happened. They no longer show up as a half message that failed to send. - **Messages stay in order:** a message that failed to send stays where you wrote it, and messages sent after it appear below it.
